subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should OpenClaw add persisted compaction trigger metadata and tighten successful-turn overflow decisions for subagent wake paths now, or wait for a broader compaction/usage policy refactor?
rationale: The remaining fix touches overflow policy, provider usage attribution, and persisted transcript schema, so automation should not choose the durable product contract alone.

options.title: Add narrow trigger and usage guard
options.body: Persist a closed compaction trigger/cause field and guard successful-turn overflow against unreliable aggregate usage for providers without exact context snapshots.

options.title: Split attribution from overflow behavior
options.body: Track persisted trigger metadata separately while leaving overflow semantics to a later provider-by-provider usage-accounting pass.

options.title: Hold for broader compaction refactor
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella until maintainers redesign compaction policy, transcript schema, and provider usage contracts together.

recommendation.title: Add narrow trigger and usage guard
recommendation.body: Persist a closed compaction trigger/cause field and guard successful-turn overflow against unreliable aggregate usage for providers without exact context snapshots.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest combined history across usage accounting and subagent session ownership in the inspected files.
